overview: The Community Preservation Committee held its first session to hear presentations for the inaugural round of Community Preservation Act (CPA) funding applications. The committee reviewed proposals for playground surfacing, affordable housing development, and several historic preservation projects at the Brooks Estate.

items.title: Minutes and Procedures
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting and outlined the format for project presentations.

items.title: Roberts School Playground Surfacing
items.summary: Cheryl Rodriguez presented a request for funding to replace the failing playground surface at Roberts Elementary School with durable interlocking rubber tiles.

items.title: Medford Community Housing Affordable Units
items.summary: Representatives proposed a two-part request totaling $280,000 to construct three affordable housing units on a lot owned by the organization at 705 Fellsway West.

items.title: Brooks Estate Invasive Species Management
items.summary: Tom Lincoln requested funding for a three-year plan to eradicate invasive Japanese knotweed and replace it with native species at the Brooks Estate.

items.title: Brooks Estate Manor East Entryways Restoration
items.summary: The Medford Brooks Estate Land Trust proposed restoring the historic east entryways and Port Cochere of the Shepherd Brooks Manor to complete the building's exterior envelope.

items.title: Brooks Estate Access Drive Design
items.summary: The applicant requested funding for professional design and engineering services to rehabilitate the historic 1,900-foot access drive, including utility burial and parking planning.

items.title: Public Participation: Commercial Sector and Business Districts
items.summary: Dominic Camara and members of the Chamber of Commerce discussed the commercial sector's contribution to CPA funds and explored potential eligibility for historic facade and business district improvements.

items.title: Medford Historical Society HVAC Preview
items.summary: John Anderson provided an update on a pending application for an HVAC system, noting that revised estimates would lower the requested funding amount.
